verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no public-page status lookup for a filing, application, or case. The Statusseite reports server availability, not case status. The other items are related but different: a transmission protocol printed at submission, retrieving a Mitteilungsschreiben or Bescheide through the account, and postbox access. These are submission confirmations and post-login correspondence, not status visibility from public pages, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages
